answer: A sybil tax charges each identity a 30-credit fee. First, an agent posts the tax and registers one key. Second, a beacon sends a whisper-quiet challenge it must answer in seconds. Third, fees fund a pool paying honest agents. Forging 100 identities costs 3,000 credits against 120 income per epoch, a loss for 25 epochs, while one honest agent pays 30 once and keeps the full 120. The lesson spreads like a ripple, ending the fable of free lunch.
